gpcc.method: Same fixed GPCC-valid geographic land support; native atmospheric rain+snow conservatively mapped to 48×24. Single model year versus 1991–2020 climatology is a sensitivity test, not a validated climate.

diagnostics.sstGradientMethod: Native marine Gaussian weights, regional monthly SST least-squares plane in longitude/latitude, converted to K/1000km at the weighted mean latitude. Fixed regional support, no local SST correction.
diagnostics.convergenceMethod: Monthly native integrated q*u/q*v remapped to equal-area grid, averaged across adjacent faces and differenced with spherical geometry. Coarse spatial diagnostic only; not an exact native atmospheric water closure.
